key_insight: Semantic Observability proposes graph-grounded, multi-agent diagnostics to trace cascading failures and generate contextual root-cause analyses.
engineering_relevance: Unifying infrastructure, software dependencies, and event timelines could help SREs reduce manual log correlation and target remediation.
method: Represent heterogeneous logs, infrastructure topology, dependencies, and event sequences in a property graph.
Orchestrate stateful agents with directed cyclic graphs to apply causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal.
Pass a pruned anomaly subgraph to an LLM for code-level root-cause analysis and actionable remediation.
evidence_signal: The paper presents architecture and conceptual benefits, with validation planned on LogHub and Train-Ticket; quantitative evaluation is deferred to a companion paper.
watch_item: Diagnostic reliability depends on accurate graph construction and causal attribution; claimed MTTR, token-use, and hallucination benefits remain unquantified.
paper_title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
